evidence_class: local fixture runs and CI on the pull request head; mocked, no live infrastructure read or mutated

states.observed: every shared fixture validates to its expected verdict in an isolated consumer that loads no producer module
states.accepted: current, previous-minor and newer-minor records admitted; future-major and missing-authority records refused before any write
states.committed: schemas, compatibility manifest and fixtures at the tested commit
states.externally_verified: CI Tests run 37688292113 on the tested commit: lint, eight unit shards, sonar, mutation (393 killed, 0 survived) and Gate passed

interfaces: docs/swarm-v2/schemas/common.json (shared envelope, identifiers, reserved authority names)
docs/swarm-v2/schemas/compatibility.json (owner, consumers, supported minors, authority fields, rules)
tests/contracts/swarm_v2/fixtures (families and index.json with expectations and hashes)
tests/contracts/swarm_v2/consumer.py (standalone consumer, jsonschema and referencing only)
scripts.swarm_v2.contracts: load, check, admit, write_version, contract_validation_failures_total

measurements.contract_validation_failures_total: counted per contract and reason on each loaded contract set; fixture runs observe unsupported_major and missing_authority for every authority contract, and 0 for supported families

rollback_rehearsal: wt.sh tmp --from the tested commit, then git revert of every branch commit since the dev merge base, on a throwaway checkout removed afterwards
rollback_rehearsal_output: (empty diff means the tree equals the dev base)
ls: cannot access 'tests/contracts': No such file or directory
rollback_command: lower write_minor in compatibility.json so producers write the previous minor while readers keep accepting both; reverting the pull request removes only schemas, fixtures and the admission module, no stored state
limitations: admit is an in-repo reference store with a host-local flock; the controller and archive services own their durable stores in later packages.
JSON Schema cannot compare sibling fields, so byte_end >= byte_start and the conditional byte range of session events are unchecked.
checkpoint_sequence and renewal_sequence ordering is owned by SV2-CKP-04 and SV2-LDG-02; these contracts publish the fields.
The producer-module check in the consumer looks for the scripts and hooks packages only.
Top-level unknown fields pass through by design; consumers read authority only from the closed authority object.
